unit: degrees (top-edge angle of picture card 1, line fit over the middle half of the edge, sub-pixel; + = right end lower)
sampling: captured pictures only (24/30 fps cadence on the 60 fps grid)
note: the two outer picture cards turn as a mirrored pair while the camera reframes up: card 1 0.2 -> 9.8 deg, card 3 0.0 -> -9.8 deg (within 0.1 deg of each other at every picture inside the turn), centre card 2 stays at 0.0; fitted to the end of the turn (f3130-3132); after it both cards dip 0.65 deg (f3135) and come back to +-9.8 deg by f3150, then hold to f3177; labels turn with their cards; the side edges do not follow (card 1's left edge leans 9.1 deg at f3112 and 4.6 deg at f3150), so the turn reads as a 3D turn rather than a flat rotation
